_purpose: The ONE place GOV.UK's Drug Safety Update 'therapeutic_area' facet is mapped to Hub speciality panel slugs (the filenames of data/speciality-panels/*.json). Read by scripts/refresh_mhra_dsu.py and re-derived by verify.py's check_mhra_dsu, so the data file and this table cannot drift apart. A facet with an empty 'hub' list is deliberately unmapped and carries the reason; a facet GOV.UK adds that is not in this table is reported in data/mhra-dsu.json 'unmappedFacets' as 'not in mapping table', never guessed. Labels are GOV.UK's own, read from https://www.gov.uk/api/content/drug-safety-update (details.facets) on 29/09/2026.
_edit: To map a facet: add the panel slug(s) to its 'hub' list and delete 'unmappedReason'. Then run python3 scripts/refresh_mhra_dsu.py, python3 scripts/stamp_notice.py, python3 verify.py.

care-home-staff.label: Care home staff
care-home-staff.unmappedReason: An audience, not a clinical speciality. Mapping it to frailty-and-older-people would be a guess about the drug's clinical area; left for a decision.

dentistry.label: Dentistry
dentistry.unmappedReason: No Hub speciality panel for dentistry.

immunology-vaccination.label: Immunology and vaccination
immunology-vaccination.unmappedReason: No Hub panel covers immunology or vaccination. infection-prevention-and-control is a different discipline; not guessed.

immunosuppression-transplantation.label: Immunosuppression and transplantation
immunosuppression-transplantation.unmappedReason: No Hub transplant panel. Renal would cover only kidney transplant; not guessed.

infectious-disease.label: Infectious disease
infectious-disease.unmappedReason: Infectious disease (treatment, antimicrobials) is not the same discipline as infection prevention and control, and sepsis is narrower. Left for a decision.
